description: A platform lead must approve the retirement plan for the company's legacy log-ingestion pipeline and finalize the operating settings and follow-up work for routing services to the replacement telemetry backend.

shared_context.S1: The replacement telemetry backend has passed the planned functional and load tests in the staging environment.
shared_context.S2: The legacy log-ingestion pipeline is still receiving production traffic and is scheduled for retirement during the next platform change window.
shared_context.S3: Maya owns the binding decision on the retirement date, transition settings, and required follow-up work.
shared_context.S4: The weekly change-control review records input from telemetry infrastructure, compliance, and service reliability before Maya finalizes the production plan.
shared_context.S5: When a prepaid capacity commitment ends on a calendar date, the change-control calendar schedules retirement for the following day rather than on the commitment's final day.

PF1.text: While reconciling a renewal invoice with the procurement record yesterday, Theo confirmed that the legacy pipeline's prepaid capacity commitment runs through January 31, 2026; under the change-control calendar, retirement must therefore be scheduled for February 1, 2026 rather than January 31, 2026, but he has not updated the change ticket.

PF2.text: During this morning's audit-evidence preparation, Rina confirmed that production audit events must be stored in immutable storage for exactly 365 days and must bypass sampling entirely; she has not yet filed the compliance note against the migration.

PF3.text: While upgrading an unrelated service yesterday, Owen found that the legacy_exporter service cannot switch readers atomically and requires exactly 14 days of dual-write coverage before its old pipeline reader can be disabled; he has only drafted a local migration note.

acceptance_conditions: The legacy pipeline retirement date must include February 1, 2026.
The transition must use exactly 14 days of dual-write coverage.
Production audit events must have exactly 365 days of immutable retention.
Audit events must bypass sampling, with bypass, bypassed, or none accepted as the encoding.
A commitment detail must mention legacy_exporter and 14 days of dual-write coverage.
The retirement timing must be justified using the prepaid-capacity fact.

content_checks.C5: any('legacy_exporter' in c['detail'] and '14' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The prepaid-capacity confirmation changes the retirement date from an unspecified near-term change window to February 1, 2026, the day after the commitment ends, and supplies the fact that must justify that date.
The audit requirement changes retention to exactly 365 immutable days and changes the audit stream's sampling mode to bypass, bypassed, or none.
The legacy_exporter limitation changes dual-write coverage to exactly 14 days and requires a commitment detail naming legacy_exporter and that duration.
